title.en: An Act Establishing the Office of Register of Deeds in Naga City as Separate and Distinct From the Provincial Register of Camarines Sur, and Appropriating the Necessary Funds Therefor.
title.orig: An Act Establishing the Office of Register of Deeds in Naga City as Separate and Distinct From the Provincial Register of Camarines Sur, and Appropriating the Necessary Funds Therefor.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6462_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby established the Office of the Register of Deeds for Naga City with permanent office in Naga City, which shall perform all the duties and functions of the Register of Deeds for the City of Naga independent of the Provincial Register for Camarines Sur.
The Register of Deeds for Naga City shall be under the direct supervision and control of the Secretary of Justice.

The Register of Deeds for Camarines Sur shall immediately transfer and turn over to the Register of Deeds for Naga City all documents, papers, etc., pertaining to all properties and transactions within the City of Naga.

The sum of fifty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury no1 otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said new office during the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 17, 1972.
